messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT — Elevated 5xx + gateway timeouts detected for edge cluster us-west-2. p95/p99 latency spike on /v1/generate. probe: https://telemetry/reports/2789012345

alice (oncall): seeing a big spike, p95 from ~120ms -> ~1.8s, p99 ~2.3s. 5xx rate jumping to ~4.7%. traffic burst started ~10m after the morning canary.

ben (sre): I can reproduce. traces show a bunch of ECONNRESETs between edge-gw and runtime pool; a lot of keepalive socket closes. Errors correlate with canary rollout at 2789009000.

carla (eng-runtime): I deployed a small keepalive/conn-reuse tweak in the runtime binary (canary). Investigating logs now. grabbing tail of runtime logs:
```
  runtime-1 | 2026-03-17T10:04:12Z ERROR grpc: read tcp 10.0.x.x:52344->10.0.y.y:443: read: connection reset by peer
  runtime-1 | 2026-03-17T10:04:13Z WARN keepalive: reuse closed socket -> retry
  runtime-1 | 2026-03-17T10:04:13Z ERROR handler: rpc failed: upstream EOF
```

alice (oncall): Given customer impact starting to show, propose immediate rollback of the canary and short reroute of traffic to edge-west-alt. Anyone object?

dave (product): Any confirmed customer failures? we should notify if impact >5 tenants.

erin (support): Support intake shows 8 distinct customer tickets in last 12m, mostly failed generations and errors surfaced in app logs. I'll start an outbound message template.

ben (sre): Plan: 1) rollback canary -> previous runtime revision 2) shift edge route for a subset of traffic to edge-west-alt 3) if rollback doesn't fully fix, enable temporary connection-circuit at the gateway. I'll coordinate.

carla (eng-runtime): initiating rollback now. command: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/runtime --to-revision=42 --namespace=prod`

incident-bot: rollback triggered by carla at 2789012410. CI/CD trace: https://ci/revs/rollback/42

alice (oncall): Observability: p99 dropping — 1.2s -> 350ms within 90s of rollback start. 5xx falling toward baseline (0.2%). Continue to monitor for full stabilization.

frank (sre): adding temporary limiters at edge: setting concurrent_outbound=250 on gateway to avoid cascading connection storms while we let pools warm.

carla (eng-runtime): rollback complete across all runtime replicas. logs now show normal handshake behavior. early traces: no ECONNRESETs for last 2m.

erin (support): sent initial customer broadcast to affected orgs with ETA for full resolution and postmortem promise.

dave (product): thanks. please capture customer list and ticket ids.

ben (sre): short postmortem notes — suspected root cause: keepalive change allowed reuse of half-closed sockets; under production connection churn this led to upstream resets and request failures. Next steps: bisect patch, add integration test that simulates TCP half-close cases, add canary health gating for runtime keepalive metrics.

alice (oncall): Handoff: ben will take the lead for the blameless postmortem and followup remediation. I'm handing oncall to ben.

ben (sre): ack. I'll collect logs, open RLW-1234 in JIRA, and schedule a 1-hour postmortem sync with eng-runtime + eng-sre.

carla (eng-runtime): adding that we should also instrument socket lifecycle counters in runtime and add an alert if reuse-before-full-handshake > 0.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED — duration ~10m. severity: Sev2. timeline: https://incidents/internal/2789012345/timeline.

alice (oncall): quick AOs: 
- ben: own postmortem/JIRA (RLW-1234)
- carla: bisect and revert PR, add integration test
- frank: keep the gateway limiter in place for 30m then reassess
- erin: complete customer follow-ups and paste list into incident doc

ben (sre): I'll keep this thread updated with investigation notes. Great collaboration — marking this as closed in Slack once postmortem created. :thumbsup:
